**Good news! You are eligible for Child Benefit for both Alex and Blake.**

Both of your children meet all the eligibility requirements:
- ✅ Both are under 16 years old (Alex is 12, Blake is 8)
- ✅ Both live with you in the UK
- ✅ You are responsible for them
- ✅ Neither has any disqualifying circumstances

You can apply for Child Benefit for both children. Only one person can claim Child Benefit per child, so as long as no one else is claiming for Alex or Blake, you should be able to successfully claim.

**Important note:** If you or your partner have an individual income over £60,000, you may have to pay the High Income Child Benefit tax charge, but this doesn't affect your eligibility to claim. You can still claim and choose whether to receive the payments or not.
